chunks: I wish it had been the destroyer (death).

key_terms.الْقَاضِيَةَ: The Destroyer, referring to Death as the one that ends life

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'al-Qadilah' mean in the context of this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Qiyamah is often interpreted as the sinner's ultimate regret upon witnessing the reality of the Hereafter, where death ('al-Qadilah') is personified as the final arbiter that severs all worldly ties. It highlights the psychological state of despair for those who denied the truth, contrasting with the believer's peaceful acceptance of death as a transition to divine proximity.
